title: Nidhögg the Primal

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Nidhögg the Primal is the upgraded form of Nidhögg using Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
An upgraded Nidhögg will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
Like all other one-handed swords it has:
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.

sections.heading: Upgrade information
sections.text: Total cost for the fully upgraded sword is 1 Nidhögg, 42 Flametal and 6 Jades. However, it is only 6 flametal and 1 Jade for level 2, which is the highest upgrade currently obtainable as of patch 218.15.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • The poison effect is considerably less effective in Ashlands than the effects of the other variants.
